terms.gloss: thin a tree by cutting out branches, so as to let the light through
evidence: Plin. NH 17.94: adultās interlūcāre jūstō plūs
Plin. NH 17.214: interlūcātā dēnsitāte rāmōrum (Lewis & Short)

terms.gloss: thin out by cutting: a farmer’s word

phrases.english: to thin grown trees out more than is right

sources: Lewis & Short: interluco · Lewis & Short: disraro
Pliny, Naturalis Historia, ed. Mayhoff (Teubner, 1906), read in the Perseus Digital Library.
